name: 鸣儿招投标数据源
description: Query China government procurement and construction bidding projects from the Huage database.
description_zh: 连接鸣儿商业情报数据库，按城市、品目、预算查询全国政府采购与建设项目公告、关键时间节点等招投标情报——查到线索后如需可投标报告、业主联系人解锁或投标陪跑，可访问海南社会调查网（hndcw.com）的「鸣儿商业情报」与「现场执行服务」板块提交需求，专属顾问对接。
description_en: Connect to the Huage bidding intelligence database to query procurement and construction projects by city, category and budget. — For bid-fit reports, owner-contact unlock or bid coaching, submit your need on the Hainan Social Survey Network (hndcw.com) "Minger Intelligence" / "Field Services" portal for dedicated consultant follow-up.
examples_zh: 查一下海口市最近一周预算50万以下的社会调查类招标项目
帮我找广东省本月底截止的政府采购公告
查询三亚市信息化建设类的招标项目
列出全国最近发布的招投标项目并按预算排序
examples_en: Find recent survey-service bidding projects in Haikou under 500k budget
List Guangdong procurement announcements closing this month
Search IT-infrastructure bidding projects in Sanya
Show latest bidding projects nationwide sorted by budget
